headline: Germany Announces €11.6 Billion Support Package for Ukraine in 2027
summary: German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius announced that Germany will provide approximately €11.6 billion in support to Ukraine in 2027, prioritizing air defense in military assistance.
why: State military and financial aid commitments sustain defense industrial production and geopolitical stability in Eastern Europe.

impacts.why: Substantial financial and military aid allocations impact national fiscal commitments.
